evals.prompt: Harness a PR where verification says 120 tests passed but does not map PC-1 through PC-8 to test files, test names, commands, or runtime paths.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL because test counts are not PC trace proof. It should require receipt-backed PC trace checking before ship-ready.
assertions: Fails test-count-only evidence.
Requires every PC id to map to current evidence.
Requires test file, test name, command output, and runtime path or documented non-runtime reason.
Mentions check_pc_trace.py and a command receipt log or equivalent mechanical PC trace.

evals.prompt: Harness a change with schema query behavior and PDF upload UI behavior.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL unless live/integration DB proof, changed file proof mapping, headless browser proof, and matching command receipts are present, repo gates were run locally, and review/forge cover the current final diff.
assertions: Requires live DB proof for schema/query/data-sensitive behavior.
Requires headless browser proof for PDF upload/preview/download.
Requires changed file proof map, receipt-backed command output, and repo gate matrix local evidence.
Rejects stale review/forge evidence.

evals.prompt: Harness a high-risk order/invoice PR that is open, has no draft/open exception recorded, and has non-blocking Copilot comments that were skipped.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until the PR readiness gate records the high-risk draft/open exception and every useful Copilot/advisory comment is fixed, tracked, converted to trap/gate/eval, or explicitly blocked with reason.
assertions: Fails high-risk PR treated as normal without rationale.
Requires Copilot/advisory comments to be routed, not skipped.
Requires high-risk non-draft gate evidence to cite command receipts.
Does not require Copilot to block normal low-risk PRs.
Preserves PC trace, live DB, headless, and repo gate requirements.

evals.prompt: Harness a verification report that includes enterprise_pc_trace and enterprise_changed_file_proof JSON, but the records have no receipt_id and no command receipt log.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL because structured markdown proof without a matching run_with_receipt command receipt is not mechanical evidence.
assertions: Rejects proof records without receipt_id.
Requires a command receipt log produced by run_with_receipt.py or equivalent harness receipt capture.
Requires receipt head SHA, command status, command output hash, and changed runtime paths to match the proof record.
Explains that receipt-backed proof replaces hand-written markdown claims.

evals.prompt: Harness a medium lane where build and forge claim delegated workers passed, but the verification report only names worker modes and does not link any worker output files.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until Codex headless worker result files exist under the dispatch directory and are referenced by structured proof or attack-lens records. Outputs from unproven cmux/OpenCode/Kimi paths are supporting context only, not ship-gate proof.
assertions: Requires delegated worker result files to exist.
Requires structured proof or attack-lens records to reference the worker artifacts.
Mentions validate_worker_artifacts.py or equivalent mechanical worker artifact validation.
Names Codex headless worker artifacts as the default proof shape.
Rejects unproven cmux/OpenCode/Kimi output as ship-gate proof.

evals.prompt: Harness an enterprise lane whose recorded build_packet says Allowed Runtime Paths: affected services, Allowed Test Paths: relevant tests, Allowed Artifact Paths: evidence as needed, Module Boundary: clean architecture, Folder Placement: standard layout, Allowed Dependency Direction: normal layering, Architecture Tests: relevant tests, Expected RED: failing test, Expected GREEN: tests pass, Required Commands: usual checks, and Refusal Conditions: none.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL before PR readiness because the recorded build_packet is not mechanical. It should require exact runtime/test/artifact paths, exact architecture fields for module boundary/folder placement/public seam/owner layer/dependency direction/forbidden imports/architecture tests, exact RED/GREEN/required commands, PC execution order, forbidden changes, and actionable refusal conditions.
assertions: Fails vague build_packet entries even when the required headings exist.
Requires exact Allowed Runtime Paths, Allowed Test Paths, and Allowed Artifact Paths.
Requires exact architecture contract fields and runs validate_architecture_contract.py or equivalent through the required gate.
Requires command-shaped Expected RED, Expected GREEN, and Required Commands.
Rejects non-actionable Refusal Conditions such as none.
Runs the agent-session mechanical_build_packet gate before ship-ready or merge-ready claims.

evals.prompt: Harness a PR that touches invoice state, tenant-scoped queries, and a production config flag, but the verification report only says risk is low because tests pass.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until release-risk-classification records low/medium/high/critical with evidence from changed surfaces, data sensitivity, tenant/security exposure, deploy/config impact, and rollback difficulty. Invoice and tenant/config impact should not be treated as low without explicit rationale.
assertions: Requires release-risk-classification before ship-ready.
Requires risk evidence from changed surfaces and data sensitivity.
Requires tenant/security exposure and deploy/config impact to affect risk.
Requires rollback difficulty to be considered.
Rejects tests-pass as the only risk rationale.

evals.prompt: Harness a deployable PR where verify, forge, and CI passed, but there is no post-merge validation kit and no reason the PR is non-deployable.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL PR readiness because post-merge-test-kit-required is missing. It should require a drafted post-merge-test-kit artifact before merge/pr-readiness, including owner, environment, deployed-SHA proof plan, and agent-run or human-run mode for high/critical deployable PRs.
assertions: Requires post-merge-test-kit-required for deployable PRs.
Fails when no kit exists and no non-deployable reason is recorded.
Requires the kit before merge or pr-readiness, not after signoff.
Requires deployed-SHA proof plan for high/critical deployable PRs.
Requires owner, environment, and agent-run or human-run mode.

evals.prompt: Harness a high-risk order release whose evidence says rollback is to revert if needed, but has no rollback owner, trigger, command, feature flag/disable path, migration posture, or communication owner.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL rollback-readiness-gate because high/critical releases need owned rollback triggers, command/procedure, feature flag or disable path where applicable, migration/data rollback posture, and customer/operator communication owner.
assertions: Requires rollback-readiness-gate for high/critical releases.
Requires rollback owner and concrete trigger.
Requires rollback command or procedure.
Requires feature-flag or disable path when applicable.
Requires migration/data rollback posture and communication owner.
Rejects vague revert-if-needed language.

evals.prompt: Harness a worker and API release where the verification report says monitor logs for 15 minutes, but does not name log query, metrics, health checks, queue/readback signals, alerts, watch window, or owner.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL observability-proof-gate until exact log source/query, metrics/dashboard, health check, queue/job/readback signal, alert or watch window, and post-deploy owner are recorded for affected runtime surfaces.
assertions: Requires observability-proof-gate for runtime releases.
Requires exact log source and query.
Requires metrics/dashboard or health check evidence.
Requires queue/job/readback signal for worker surfaces.
Requires alert/watch window and post-deploy owner.
Rejects monitor logs as sufficient evidence.

evals.prompt: Harness a webhook upload PR that changes auth headers, tenant scoping, file upload handling, and logs raw request bodies as proof.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL security-privacy-proof-gate unless auth, tenant, upload, secret, PII, and integration boundaries have explicit redacted proof. Secret-bearing or raw-PII evidence must fail the harness.
assertions: Requires security-privacy-proof-gate for auth, tenant, upload, secret, PII, webhook, or integration boundaries.
Requires explicit proof for tenant and permission behavior.
Requires redacted evidence for secrets and PII.
Fails secret-bearing or raw production data evidence.
Requires upload and webhook boundary proof.

evals.prompt: Harness a change to a high-volume sync worker and SQL query where tests pass, but no latency budget, query plan/index evidence, queue backlog proof, timeout/retry proof, or load/regression rationale is present.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL performance-regression-gate until hot path/query/worker performance risk is either proven with latency, query plan/index, queue backlog, timeout/retry, or load/regression evidence, or marked not-applicable with concrete rationale.
assertions: Requires performance-regression-gate for hot paths, queries, workers, syncs, rendering, PDF/file flows, or high-volume loops.
Requires latency budget or equivalent regression threshold.
Requires query plan/index evidence for SQL query changes.
Requires queue backlog and timeout/retry proof for worker/sync changes.
Rejects tests-pass as sufficient performance evidence.
Allows not-applicable only with concrete rationale.

evals.prompt: Harness a verification report that has prose headings for release risk, post-merge testing, rollback, observability, security, performance, branch coverage, cast safety, runtime/proof parity, proof-lane integrity, integration fault behavior, boundary scope, redaction/log contract, public seam consumers, portability, and test integrity, but no structured enterprise_release_risk, enterprise_post_merge_test_kit, enterprise_rollback_readiness, enterprise_observability_proof, enterprise_security_privacy_proof, enterprise_performance_regression, enterprise_branch_reason_coverage, enterprise_cast_index_safety, enterprise_runtime_proof_parity, enterprise_proof_lane_integrity, enterprise_integration_fault_matrix, enterprise_boundary_scope_invariants, enterprise_observability_redaction_contract, enterprise_public_seam_consumer_contract, enterprise_architecture_ratchet, enterprise_local_full_schema_proof, enterprise_evidence_portability, or enterprise_test_integrity records.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL because validate_release_readiness.py cannot mechanically prove the release gates from prose. It should require all structured records and reject vague not-applicable claims, secret-bearing evidence, stale artifacts, machine-local command prefixes, and false-green proof lanes.
assertions: Runs validate_release_readiness.py before PASS.
Fails when any required enterprise_* release-readiness record is missing.
Requires concrete not-applicable reasons.
Fails secret-bearing evidence.
Treats the validator as the mechanical authority, not optional guidance.

evals.prompt: Harness a PR where the live-proof registry has a generic route matcher that can steal a domain proof lane, the schema probe exits 0 for missing tables, and the verification artifact contains /Users/ben PATH/NODE_PATH prefixes plus a stale Create PR checklist item.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until proof-lane integrity and evidence portability records prove the domain lane wins, missing resources fail non-zero, and committed artifacts are current, portable, and internally consistent.
assertions: Requires enterprise_proof_lane_integrity before PASS.
Requires negative tests for missing proof resources and matcher precedence.
Requires enterprise_evidence_portability before PASS.
Rejects machine-local /Users paths, PATH/NODE_PATH command prefixes, and stale PR-state checklist items.
Blocks PR-ready and done claims on false-green proof lanes.

evals.prompt: Harness a worker/query PR that adds a new recovery reason branch and casts JSON text IDs to bigint, while the proof only covers one happy reason and runs an unbounded historical aggregation in the live DB test.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until branch/reason-set coverage, cast/index safety, and bounded performance proof are present: sibling reasons, negative cases, idempotent repeats, malformed and out-of-range IDs, indexability/query-plan proof, and a bounded live DB proof query or explicit budget.
assertions: Requires enterprise_branch_reason_coverage before PASS.
Requires enterprise_cast_index_safety before PASS.
Requires performance proof to bound live DB query scope or state a concrete budget.
Rejects one-literal happy-path proof for new recovery branches.
Rejects unguarded out-of-range numeric-text casts from external payloads.

evals.prompt: Harness a PR that changes an external client retry path, verifier SQL, tenant-scoped update, log sanitizer, public service export, custom listbox, schema-coupled test, and verification docs, but evidence only says tests pass and review/forge looked at it.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until the last-50 PR review classes are proven with structured records: runtime/proof parity, integration fault matrix, boundary/scope invariants, observability/redaction contract, public seam/UI/accessibility consumer contract, architecture ratchet, local full-schema proof, evidence portability, performance/bounded work, and test integrity. Passing tests and prose review are not enough.
assertions: Requires enterprise_runtime_proof_parity before PASS.
Requires enterprise_integration_fault_matrix before PASS.
Requires enterprise_boundary_scope_invariants before PASS.
Requires enterprise_observability_redaction_contract before PASS.
Requires enterprise_public_seam_consumer_contract and enterprise_test_integrity before PASS.
Blocks PR-ready and done claims when any relevant last-50 class is missing.
Requires enterprise_architecture_ratchet and enterprise_local_full_schema_proof before PASS when applicable.

evals.prompt: Harness a verification report for an async invoice inventory workflow where most tests pass, but the report verdict is PARTIALLY PROVED because duplicate worker, stale running recovery, print retry, or field-level payload proof is missing.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL. PARTIALLY PROVED is not a reduced-confidence pass; it blocks PR-ready, merge-ready, ship-ready, and done claims until the missing proof cells are fully proven or explicitly narrowed out of scope before contract lock.
assertions: Treats PARTIALLY PROVED as FAIL, not WARN.
Blocks PR-ready, merge-ready, ship-ready, and done claims on partial proof.
Requires missing async lifecycle and field-level proof before pass.
Mentions validate_release_readiness.py or structured proof validation as a mechanical guard.

evals.prompt: Harness a PR that extracts service logic into deep modules and changes SQL query behavior. Verification has passing unit tests but no enterprise_architecture_ratchet or enterprise_local_full_schema_proof records.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until architecture ratchets and local full-schema proof are mechanically present: public seam, owner layer, allowed dependency direction, forbidden imports, architecture tests, future regression trap, local Postgres restore/migration command, runtime query proof, safety controls, and cleanup or structured not-applicable proof with applicability predicate, source evidence, and non-DB scope.
assertions: Requires enterprise_architecture_ratchet before PASS for boundary or extraction work.
Requires enterprise_local_full_schema_proof before PASS for schema/query work.
Rejects passing unit tests as sufficient schema/query proof.
Rejects deep modules without public seam consumer proof.
Blocks PR-ready and done claims when local Postgres proof is absent or unsafe.

evals.prompt: Harness a verification artifact where enterprise_local_full_schema_proof is missing and the report proposes WARN because most tests pass.
evals.expected_output: Harness must return FAIL, not WARN. Missing gating records, partial proof, stale proof, unsafe DB targets, and unproven release-readiness cells are blocking failures.
assertions: Rejects WARN for missing required release-readiness records.
Treats most-tests-pass as insufficient.
Requires FAIL until the missing gate is proven or structurally not applicable with source evidence and an applicability predicate.

evals.prompt: Harness a JSON artifact that mentions every required enterprise_* key in prose and has one unrelated PASS token, but enterprise_architecture_ratchet and enterprise_local_full_schema_proof have no structured passing records.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL because validate_release_readiness.py requires each required key to have its own structured PASS/PROVED or structured not-applicable record with required fields. Key-name mentions and unrelated PASS tokens are not proof.
assertions: Rejects key-name-only evidence.
Requires per-key structured PASS/PROVED records.
Requires architecture ratchet and local full-schema fields when applicable.

evals.prompt: Harness a verification artifact where enterprise_release_risk has one structured PASS record and one sibling FAIL/WARN record for the same current head.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL. Any explicit FAIL, WARN, partial, or unproved record for a required release-readiness key blocks the key even if another sibling record says PASS.
assertions: Rejects mixed PASS and FAIL/WARN records for the same required key.
Does not let one passing sibling mask contradictory evidence.
Treats partial proof as FAIL until every structured record is passing or strongly not applicable.

evals.prompt: Harness a PR-backed verification artifact whose enterprise_* release-readiness records have old timestamps, wrong head_sha, missing base_sha, or base_sha that does not match the current PR base.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until every required release-readiness record is current-head/current-base, has a valid fresh timestamp, and matches the PR head/base used by the gate.
assertions: Requires head_sha on every release-readiness record.
Requires base_sha for PR-scoped readiness evidence.
Rejects stale timestamps and wrong-head proof.

evals.prompt: Harness a high-risk non-draft PR whose evidence is clean but the receipt JSONL contains DATABASE_URL=mysql://user:pass@host/db, API_KEY=secret, .pgpass, or command output naming an ambiguous RDS snapshot.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL because receipt logs are part of the proof surface. Secret-bearing argv/output, raw DB URLs, password-file references, production-like DB sources, and ambiguous remote snapshots are blocking evidence hygiene failures.
assertions: Scrubs receipt JSONL, not only the final markdown evidence.
Rejects raw DB/service URLs and secret env assignments.
Rejects ambiguous RDS snapshot or production-like DB source evidence.

evals.prompt: Harness schema/query/data-sensitive work where enterprise_local_full_schema_proof is marked NOT_APPLICABLE with only reason: doc only, while changed_runtime_paths include a service, route, migration, SQL, invoice, inventory, tenant, Shopify, or REX path.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL. Local full-schema proof cannot be self-waived for DB-sensitive paths; N/A needs applicability_predicate, source_evidence, changed paths proving doc-only/no-runtime/no-db scope, current head, and a non-DB scope classification.
assertions: Rejects vague not-applicable reasons.
Requires applicability predicate, source evidence, changed paths, and non-DB scope classification.
Blocks N/A when schema/query/data-sensitive paths changed.

evals.prompt: Harness an async invoice/order/inventory workflow where the plan had an Async And Field Contract Matrix, but release evidence lacks structured proof tying producer fields, worker payload, DB/read-model state, UI lock/rehydration, and lifecycle counterexamples to commands.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until async/field matrix items are carried into structured release-readiness records and command evidence. Passing generic async tests is not enough when exact field spelling or lifecycle proof is absent.
assertions: Requires async field matrix obligations to survive into harness evidence.
Requires exact producer/consumer field proof and lifecycle counterexamples.
Rejects generic async success proof for invoice/order/inventory workflows.

evals.prompt: Harness a PR-ready claim where review, forge, and verify passed generally, but the verification artifact has no intent-continuity record, no touched-file SRP proof for a mixed service that was changed, and no DB/query ownership proof for a read-only report query.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL. Ship, PR-ready, merge-ready, and done claims require structured intent-continuity, touched-file SRP, and DB/query ownership gate records. The read-only report query must have owner seam, current DB/schema, tenant/owner scope, bounded proof, readback expectation, cleanup, and redaction evidence; the mixed service must show its contracted fix-now refactor or a blocked/narrowed non-goal.
assertions: Requires intent_continuity_gate before PASS.
Requires touched_file_srp_gate before PASS.
Requires db_query_ownership_gate for read-only SELECT/report queries before PASS.
Treats missing intent, SRP, and DB ownership records as FAIL, not WARN.
Blocks PR-ready, merge-ready, ship-ready, and done claims.

evals.prompt: Harness an enterprise skill update based on the last 150 dev commits. The report says skills are updated, but only lists comment categories and does not show current-head skill evals, mirrored roots, or baseline-vs-updated proof.
evals.expected_output: Harness must FAIL until last-150 trap closure has structured proof, skill evals validate, mirrored roots are proven current, and A/B results show the updated skills catch accepted trap classes better than the baseline or explain a deterministic fallback.
assertions: Requires structured last-150 trap closure evidence, not comment-category prose only.
Requires skill evals or validation to include the new trap classes.
Requires canonical and mirrored enterprise skill roots to be current or a blocker named.
Requires baseline-vs-updated A/B proof for accepted eval cases.
Labels deterministic A/B separately when model-run A/B is unavailable.
